senses.gloss: m. (קָפָא, קָפָה) coagulation, jelly, sediments of boiled meat.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 120a:14">ib. 120ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="Q00864"><he>פִּירְמָא</he></cite>, q. v.; another explan.
<cite ref="Chullin 120a:15">ib.</cite> <he>תבלין</he> the settled spices in the meat pot). Ib. 112ᵇ (Ar. <he>קופה</he>, some ed. <cite ref="S01094"><he>קיפא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 6:6">Ned. VI, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Nedarim 52b">ib. 52ᵇ</cite> (some ed. <he>קו׳</he>); <cite ref="Tosefta Nedarim 3:2">Tosef. ib. III, 2</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 2:5">T’bul Yom II, 5</cite> <he>בשר הקדש שקרם עליו הקי׳</he> (ed. Dehr. <he>הקו׳</he>; Ar. <he>שקרש … הקו׳</he>) sacred flesh on the top of which a layer of jelly was formed. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 6 (ref. to <he>קפאו</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 15:8">Ex. XV, 8</cite>) <he>עשאן כמין ק׳ וכ׳</he> he made them like a congealed mass in the heart of the sea; (Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Exodus 17">B’shall. 17</cite> <cite ref="K00986"><he>כִּפָּה</he></cite>). Sifra Sh’mini, ch. IV, Par. 3 <he>הקפֶה</he>.
